message:
How it reads now:
Requests sheet
Who (person, required, whoever adds it), Type (Vacation, Sick or Personal, required), From (date, required), To (date, required), Note (long text).
A request is added only when Left in Balances for the same Who is empty or Days at most Left in Balances for the same Who (Within your balance).

Balances sheet
Who (person, required), Year (number), Days a year (days), Used (days).

Holidays sheet
Date (date, required), Holiday (text, required).

Steps
Submitted → Approved → Declined or Taken
Approved: not by the person who asked
Declined: not by the person who asked

What happens by itself
Requests go to the person’s manager.
When a request is approved, tell the person and Lena.
When a request is declined, tell the person and Lena.

Who can see and do what
Lena Ortiz and Wade Wilson see every request, add, edit and move them, and change how it works.
Everyone sees their own requests and balances and can add them.
Everyone sees every holiday.
Everyone sees their team’s requests and can move them.

Connections
People fills Who.
People fills Who.

Coming soon
Connections to other software

Latest message from Wade Wilson:
Keep leave in a ledger: an approved request takes its days off as an entry, and Left counts the entries.
